findings.title: PLAY-N sconce canopies cannot cover the 4" square surface box (box+cover 2-5/8" proud vs 2-1/2" fixture; 1" backplate vs 4-3/16" cover)

evidence.measured: Six sconces on bare concrete take a surface RACO 232 (4x4x2-1/8) under a 1/2" raised cover = 2.625" proud, 4"+ square. WAC Roland WS-83212 projects 2.5" (type height 12, footprint 4.5x2.5); Ferguson lists backplate 4.5 W x 1 H in. Box+cover is deeper than the fixture and 3+ in taller than its backplate, so it shows above/below the canopy.
evidence.expected: Fixture canopy fully covers the box: projection > box+cover, backplate >= box height, or a shallow/flush mount (e.g. 1-1/2" box, or the can-style canopy). The TODO item is real.
evidence.method: Probe /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-colincatlin-Documents-NoCloud-TypeHaus/a9292deb-6aa8-41a7-a63e-497e3c7970b9/scratchpad/geometry-review/M3/p1.py (box rows); box_size from device_boxes.py BOX_STANDARD; web: Ferguson WS-83212-BK page (backplate 1x4.5, ext 2.5). Sources disagree on body width (4.5 vs 2.5) so recheck the install sheet.

findings.proposed_fix: Pick a sconce with a >=4-1/2" square, >=2-3/4" deep canopy or a plain 4" box (no raised cover, 1-1/2" deep) with a canopy that hides it; or recess the six on a furred face. Product swap, owner decision.

findings.title: Service panels hung with bottom at 60" AFF: top breaker handle ~90-93" vs NEC 240.24(A)/404.8(A) 6'-7" (79")

evidence.measured: ED-B-PANEL body z -49.4..-13.4 (60"..96" above the basement floor, 36" tall); PANEL-2 60"..90"; BACKUP-PANEL mount ft(5). Highest possible handle is a few inches under the top: ~90-93" > 79".
evidence.expected: Highest breaker handle <= 79" above the floor (240.24(A)); a 36" can then has its bottom <= ~40". The plan comments apply 404.8(A) to disconnects but nothing grades panels.
evidence.method: Probe p10.py canvas_objects body_z0/z1 minus storey -109.44". Mount elevation 60 is the body bottom (resolved z_m).

findings.proposed_fix: Lower the four mounts (elevation ~ 36-40"); conduit start/end elevations (absolute -48") and the trunk heights follow. Also: a 54-space 225A enclosure is modelled 20x36x4, shorter than real 54-space cans, so true top is higher still.

findings.title: Raceway solids, derived sleeves and concrete-crossing sleeve sizes use trade size as the diameter (3/4" EMT drawn 0.75", OD is 0.922")

evidence.measured: round_profile(trade_size_m/2) drawn: 3/4" -> 0.75" dia, 1" -> 1.0, 1-1/4 -> 1.25, 2" -> 2.0. raceway_outside_diameter_m (pipe_sections.py:105) gives 0.922 / 1.163 / 1.51 / 2.375 and is already used by mep_envelopes.py:131 and floor_blocking.py:564. mep_concrete passes trade_size as the diameter a cast sleeve must clear.
evidence.expected: EMT OD: 1/2 0.706, 3/4 0.922, 1 1.163, 1-1/4 1.510, 1-1/2 1.740, 2 2.197 in (NEC Ch.9 T4/ nominal). Solids, clearance and sleeve checks should use the OD.
evidence.method: grep trade_size_m/2 in resolve/; compare with raceway_outside_diameter_m; routing/conduit.py:37 docstring admits the under-statement.

findings.source: NEC Chapter 9 Table 4 / Table 2 EMT dimensions; pipe_sections.RACEWAY_OD_IN
findings.proposed_fix: Use raceway_outside_diameter_m(run.trade_size_m, run.material) in device_drops.py:47, mep.py:242 and mep_concrete.py:183 (goldens: conduit solids, sleeve findings).

findings.title: ED-A-POCKET-SW box overlaps the 3-1/2" casing leg of the pocket hatch

evidence.measured: Switch box x-span overlaps casing leg_left by 0.56" including a 2.75" plate (box alone ~0.3"); box z 276.0-279.7 vs leg z 240.9-277.6 (storey frame, attic).
evidence.expected: Switch plate edge >= ~1" clear of casing (or switch on the opposite jamb).
evidence.method: Probe p6.py: casing pieces projected on wall axis vs box face_point +/- max(box,plate)/2, same side.

findings.source: model.door_casings pieces; Leviton Decora plate 2.75" wide
findings.proposed_fix: Move ED-A-POCKET-SW ~2" along the wall (check the rake) or narrow the casing; casing resolver does not treat devices as obstacles (_obstacles lists no ElectricalDevice).

findings.title: Six switches/receptacles sit <1" from casing legs (plate edge to casing): BATH1-SW 0.83", LIVING-RC10 0.70", S-PLANT-SW-TIMER/M-CLOSET-SW/S-NCLOSET-SW 0.94-0.95"

evidence.measured: Gaps 0.70-0.95" between a 2.75" plate and the same-face casing leg; no overlap, no casing clip recorded (casing keeps full 3-1/2"/1-1/2" width).
evidence.expected: Buildable but tight; casing nails and plate screws fine at >=1/2".

findings.title: Raceways leave the panel wall 12" out and run at 61" AFF through the 36" working space in front of the panels

evidence.measured: Path starts at x=24" (panel face x=12"), z -48 (61.4" AFF, just above the panel bottom at 60"); CD-B-SPA then runs ~28 ft along x=24 at that height; the attic riser stands at x=19.6, y=404 beside the group.
evidence.expected: Raceways terminate at the enclosure (no unmodelled 12" gap); anything crossing the 30" x 36" x 78" working space (110.26(A)) should be only the panel's own conductors.
evidence.method: Probe p12.py (conduit path/z) vs panel footprint x 8..12, p11.py intersect with W (x 12..48, y 288..402).

findings.proposed_fix: Re-route off the working space or add the stub from the knockout; routing is M2/I-area.

findings.title: Surface boxes for PLAY-N-RC1/DATA1 are 4" proud of the wall inside FURN-B-PLAY-TV's footprint

evidence.measured: Box+cover ring (2.625" proud, 4" wide) overlaps FURN-B-PLAY-TV footprint by 16 sq in; TV body z -78.9..-28.8 vs box z -79.9..-75.9 (3" of z overlap).
evidence.expected: Wall-hung TV with a box behind it needs the box recessed or the TV standing off >= box + plug.
evidence.method: Probe p8.py (device_footprint vs canvas footprint with z overlap).

findings.proposed_fix: Raise the outlets above or below the TV, or give the TV a stand-off; confirm any authored relation.

findings.title: E-601 service load uses 4,479 ft2 conditioned area; the house standard (N1103 / CFA note) is 4,900 ft2

evidence.measured: E-601 prints 'Conditioned floor area 4,479 ft2' and general lighting 13,436 VA at 3 VA/ft2.
evidence.expected: Same CFA as code.N1103 (4,900 sf); NEC 220.82 area is from outside dimensions, so the two figures should reconcile or the sheet should say why they differ (~1.3 kVA).
evidence.method: Read p.156 of permit_set_full.pdf; compare notes/conditioned_floor_area.md.

findings.proposed_fix: Either relabel the line or feed the NEC 220.82 area from the same derivation.

findings.title: Carlon BH235A modelled 4.0W x 3.75H; retailer data conflict (3.55x2.11 vs catalog 3-7/8 x 4-1/8)

evidence.measured: box_size (4.0, 3.75, 3.5) in; Elliott/Stoneway list 3.55 L x 2.11 W (single-gang style data), Lowe's Carlon catalog PDF lists 3-7/8 x 4-1/8 x 3-1/2.

findings.title: Nora NSIC-401QAT housing: height 6", cutout and frame dims sourced from retailers (no sheet read); can type footprint 5x5 vs 8-1/2" frame; NS-76W/NS-12 unconfirmed

evidence.measured: Retailer listings: height 6", cutout 4-1/4 vs 4-3/8, depth 6-3/8 (Steiner); the Nora PDF could not be parsed here. Source string says 'Not read' for NS-12 and 'No sheet found' for NS-76W.
evidence.expected: Spec sheet values; ceiling_can_framing grades a 5x5x6 body, the bar hangers and 8-1/2" frame ride across bays.

findings.proposed_fix: Confirm 6-3/8" height against the 11-7/8" joist cavity (passes by 5") and cutout 4-3/8".

findings.title: WAC Roland WS-83212 dimensions disagree across sources (width 4.5" vs 2.5")

evidence.measured: Type footprint 4.5x2.5x12; Ferguson: 12 H x 4.5 W, ext 2.5, backplate 1H x 4.5W; Xologic/El Design: width 2.5.

findings.proposed_fix: Read the WAC sheet; settle width and backplate.
